defmodule ShipOrder do
  @doc "Submit one shipment for an order using its durable operation_id."
  def run(carrier, order) do
    case Shipping.create(carrier, order.operation_id, order) do
      {:error, :timeout} -> Shipping.create(carrier, order.operation_id, order)
      result -> result
    end
  end
end
